title: DJ TURN ME UP
chain: Drawn from the compiled State Graph: B01 ANTICIPATION (chin nested) → B02 ACTION_EXTREME (a thousand light years) → B03 CONTACT/OVERSHOOT (diverging rings) → B04 SETTLE (eleven petals) → B05 PERCEPTION (three roads) → B06 SETTLE (chin high). 6 keys + 2 asymmetric breakdowns; timing = the beats' measured 24 fps durations (228 f).
method: Keys and breakdowns drawn with image generation, using the poem's own cel frame (f36) as the style and plate reference: camera locked, crowd held on Plane 0/1, light burst held on Plane 6. Plate continuity is MEASURED (mean gray drift in the outer 22% strips vs K01; locked if < 12). Silhouette, volume and arcs on these drawings were judged by eye, not measured. In-betweens are not drawn: this is the key-plus-breakdown flip test.

drawings.note: chin nested: spine in a forward C, knees loaded, arms hanging
pelvis leads up; head and arms still drag (not a 50% blend)
full stretch: reverse C, arms in a V against the light
torso drops first; arms arc down, jacket and hair lag upward
landing squash, arms overshoot outward, dust at the contact
hand to the heart, weight on one leg
head leads into profile; shoulders have not followed
chin high toward the sunrise: held resolve

rejected.why: crowd on Plane 0/1 vanished and the sky plate changed: continuity broken, redrawn with K05 as plate reference
